top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs Raises December Brent Oil Price Forecast to $105
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs commodity analysts have revised their price forecast for Brent crude upwards, now expecting the benchmark to average $105 in December and remain elevated next year as well. top_signals.title: The Pentagon-Silicon Complex and the Rise of the Neo-Primes
top_signals.summary:
What happens when the military depends on technologies it doesn’t own? Sharon Weinberger, the new editor-in-chief of the Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists, stops by the studio to discuss her book, Valley of Death: How Big Tech Is Fueling the Future of War. She delves into the Pentagon’s disputes with SpaceX and Anthropic, why the tech industry’s split from the military was about money more than ideology, and how a new generation of firms could become the next primes. Image: Petty Officer 1st Class Alexander Kubitza via DVIDS.

alerts.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
alerts.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
